Rope naturally passes through/over the stopper and continues across water. Period rural mechanism around 1910, no modern fittings. The rope and stopper should be easy to distinguish from existing mooring rope. Leave foreground pier edge and right foreground water exactly unchanged for overlay compatibility. Nothing else changes. Use case: historical-scene. Asset type: fixed-camera 2D point-and-click game background, R1 near river ferry pier. Generate ONE opaque PNG, requested exact 2048×1152, 16:9.
Image 1 is APPROVED ART STYLE and camera/detail reference only: match its soft painterly realistic natural materials, visible brushwork, restrained colors, no hard low-poly edges. Do NOT copy the house interior. Image 2 is the character costume-era reference only; do NOT render her or any other person.
Scene: Russian North around 1900–1920, purchased ordinary period things, late autumn, NO SNOW. A broad muddy shore and a sturdy wooden ferry landing. Horizon about 45% down the canvas, fixed camera like the approved room, enough open ground to walk across the lower central area. Cold diffuse grey daylight from overcast sky, wet earth, bare trees, muted blue-grey water. Opposite bank visible across the river but softly indistinct.
Composition and clickable objects: the river stretches across the middle background; at right a short wooden landing with an old wooden rowboat tied alongside, its gunwales and interior visible; thick ferry rope with a clearly visible near-side wooden stopper/cleat beside the landing at right. At left, near the path, a tall timber post holds an UNLIT old oil signal lantern; a separate small wooden instruction board on a post beside it, blank without any lettering. Bare-bank path exits left and gently recedes towards the village out of frame. Leave open walkable shore across the lower middle. All gameplay objects clear enough to inspect. Complete ground plane, quiet static water substrate, no decorative extras obscuring objects.
Layer contract: this is BACKGROUND only. Do NOT put an occluding near edge of the landing in the bottom foreground; it will be a separate transparent layer. Do NOT add high foreground waves or reeds. No characters, humans, animals, text, readable writing, lettering, UI, cursor, logos, glow, fire, smoke, airborne particles or falling snow. Nothing modern, no electricity, no fantasy ornament.
